regime.skew: call-rich near-money (-0.57), put-rich deep tail (10D put 16.1% vs 13.3% ATM)
regime.label: Dealer short-gamma up to the 1120 flip, spot pressed 4 points under the 1080 call wall with IV at a 5-session low
evidence: 1120 is the gamma flip: cumulative net dealer gamma is negative from 1000 upward (-4,500 baht of delta per index point at the 1076 anchor) and only crosses positive at 1120, so dealers hedge with the move across the entire 1076-1120 corridor. The book is thin in absolute terms, so read the sign, not the size.

2,246 calls sit at 1080 versus 1,135 puts, and spot at 1076 is 4 points (0.44 sigma) beneath it; the near put wall is 26 points away at 1050 (1,277 OI, 193 lots traded), so the structure is asymmetric to the upside.

16,540 call OI is up 13.8% in 5 sessions against 7.4% for puts, with +888 contracts at 1150, +346 at 1140, +325 at 1120 and +298 at 1100; today's flow ran 2,724 call lots to 1,783 put lots (P/C vol 0.65, lowest since 27 Jun).
13.29% ATM IV is the lowest in 5 sessions and 0.31 points off the 23-session low of 12.98%, so the 9.01-point 1-sigma day is priced for calm while dealer positioning is set to amplify.

S50U26.today_summary: 1076.0 closed 4.6 lower with 55 days to the 29 Sep expiry, leaving spot 6 points above max pain 1070 and 4 points below the 1080 call wall. P/C OI fell to 1.73 from 1.84 and P/C volume to 0.65, the most call-skewed flow since late June, as 2,724 call lots traded against 1,783 puts. ATM IV compressed to 13.29% while the 25-delta skew flipped to -0.57 (call-rich). The 910 put wall carries 10,201 OI but only 35 lots and sits 15.4% out of the money, so it fails the Vol2Vol test and should be treated as structural residue, not active support.
what_changed: Max pain drifted up 10 points to 1070 after holding 1060 for four straight sessions, its first upward step since 24 Jul.
The gamma flip migrated 10 points higher to 1120 from 1110, widening the short-gamma corridor above spot to 44 points (4.9 sigma days).
25-delta skew flipped from +0.60 to -0.57 on genuine repricing, not strike migration: at a constant 1040 strike put IV fell 0.91 points to 13.90% while 1120 call IV rose 0.12 to 14.33%.
The near put wall stayed at 1050 while 1080 puts shed 177 contracts over 5 sessions, so protection is being rolled down rather than defended at the money.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: Since 28 Jul the future has slipped 7.8 points to 1076 while call OI added 2,004 contracts (+13.8%) against 1,963 for puts (+7.4%), which is why P/C OI has fallen from 1.83 to 1.73 despite puts still growing in absolute terms. The call build is stacked high and away, +888 at 1150, +346 at 1140, +325 at 1120 and +298 at 1100, all of it upside strikes that push the gamma flip out of reach rather than capping price. The put build went the other way and downward, +515 at 1020, +197 at 1060 and +186 at 1070, while 1080 and 1090 puts lost 252 contracts combined, so the protection bid is retreating from the money into the 1020-1070 corridor. ATM IV has compressed 1.72 points from 15.01% to 13.29% across those same 5 sessions, so the whole structure is being rebuilt at progressively cheaper vol. The combination reads as positioning for a range break rather than a range hold: dealers stay short gamma anywhere below 1120, and the 44-point gap between spot and the flip is the fuel.

strategies.name: Call debit spread 1080 / 1120
strategies.rationale: Buys the 4-point gap to the 1080 call wall and sells at the 1120 gamma flip, so the whole 40-point width sits inside the corridor where dealers are short gamma and hedge with the move (heatmap-zones: short gamma amplifies).
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit paid, capped at the 40-point width; max gain = 40 - net debit.
strategies.invalidation: A close below 1050, the live near put wall (1,277 OI on 193 lots), kills the squeeze premise.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1060 / 1020
strategies.rationale: Maps exactly onto where 5 sessions of protection actually went, +197 contracts at 1060 and +515 at 1020, and 13.29% ATM IV makes that 40-point corridor the cheapest downside insurance in the visible history.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit paid, capped at the 40-point width; max gain = 40 - net debit.
strategies.invalidation: A close back above the 1080 call wall re-establishes the upside path and voids the hedge thesis.

strategies.name: Long strangle 1110 call / 1040 put
strategies.rationale: Owns both 25-delta bands while ATM IV sits at 13.29%, 0.31 points off the 23-session low, with dealers short gamma below 1120; the weakest of the three because 55 days of theta and IV-crush risk work against it if 1076 simply holds its 9.01-point range (iv-crush).
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = total premium paid for both legs, lost in full if the index expires between 1040 and 1110.
strategies.invalidation: ATM IV printing below 13.0% with spot still inside 1067-1085 means the compression is winning and the structure bleeds.

S50U26.prediction: 1120 is the level that matters: dealers stay short gamma below it, so a sustained push through the 1080 call wall should travel further and faster than the 9.01-point 1-sigma day implies, with the fresh 1100-1150 call OI marking where the flow expects it to end. The base case is an upward-biased grind against a 1070 max-pain anchor that has just stepped 10 points higher. A close below 1050 invalidates this and turns the same short-gamma book into downside acceleration toward the 1020 strike where 515 puts were added this week.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only, not trade advice, and no position sizing is implied. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker here than for share-settled single stocks: treat max pain 1070 and the 1120 gamma flip as tendencies, not guarantees. The 910 put wall's 10,201 OI is stale by the Vol2Vol test (35 lots, 15.4% out of the money) and must not be read as live support. Defined risk is not risk-free: each debit structure can lose the full premium paid, and macro or news flow can override the option structure outright. Data reflects the 5 Aug session, scraped 6 Aug 00:40 (+07:00); the 6 Aug session had not yet been scraped at generation time.
